text.p: Portuguese cash bonds and futures were slightly higher as the market waited to see if the Bank of Portugal would cut its repurchase pact rate at the start of a new commercial bank cash reserves period.
The central bank is due to announce its terms, which are effective from tomorrow, at around 1415 GMT.
Dealers said they expected a rate cut of 25 basis points which might lend some support to five-year maturities but would not boost 10-year bonds which were closely tracking their Spanish equivalents.
The central bank earlier injected 70 billion escudos of one-day funds at a weighted average 6.9013 percent.
The escudo was steady at around its closing levels. At 1300 GMT it was quoted at 100.90/93 per mark.
